stem: Marram grass, Ammophila arenaria, is an important plant of sand dunes. Leaves are adapted to reduce water loss by transpiration. Fig. 2.1 is a photomicrograph of a section through the leaf.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.stem:
Examples include a thick cuticle, no stomata on the outer surface, and stomata in pits on the inner surface.
